recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit. It is a narrow restoration of the already-approved non-substantive color correction after a later CSS refactor reintroduced the gold publication flag.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asking to improve harsh page colors, including the orange/gold version flag, blue-on-red footer links, and yellow side menus.
initial_application: Applied in svn revision 14598, now git commit 26b87b075e1b3a536e672ca38ac633d56831eeec, which changed the original inline publication notices from gold to #ffefef, footer links to softer colors, and div.itoc from #ffeb7e to #fffbe6.
additional_context: A later tidy-up commit, e87fa1ae313b3ebc1514036064d589b66c624392, introduced tools/html/fhir-pub.css with gold backgrounds for p#publish-box-current and p#publish-box. The active header template loads fhir-pub.css, and current published FHIR pages use id="publish-box" for the release header. FHIR-13636 shared the original svn revision but concerned icon contrast rather than this CSS notice color.
reconciliation: Changed tools/html/fhir-pub.css so p#publish-box-current and p#publish-box use #ffefef instead of gold. Other current colors and unrelated icon assets were left unchanged.
source_changes: tools/html/fhir-pub.css: changed p#publish-box-current background-color from gold to #ffefef.
tools/html/fhir-pub.css: changed p#publish-box background-color from gold to #ffefef.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same svn revision 14598, but it requested darker resource/type icons, so it was not decided as part of this CSS color-scheme fix.
